title: Fields of The World: Field Boundaries for Brazil
description: Monthly land use classification data for 1,854 agricultural fields in western Bahia, Brazil (October 2019–September 2020). The dataset documents primary crop types and land use patterns in the Luís Eduardo Magalhães region derived from remote sensing analysis.

_readme.text:
## Description

This dataset is the supplementary data of a paper published in the Data in Brief Journal. The dataset, in ESRI shapefile format (spatial reference system: WGS 84, EPSG: 4326), provides monthly land use information about 1854 fields from October 2019 to September 2020 from Luís Eduardo Magalhães (LEM) and other municipalities in the west of Bahia state, Brazil. The majority of the 16 land uses classes are related to crops. The paper describes the applied data collection methods and procedures. 

`Oldoni, Lucas Volochen ; Sanches, Ieda Del’Arco ; Picoli, Michelle Cristina A. ; Covre, Renan Moreira ; Fronza, José Guilherme  (2020), “LEM+ dataset: for agricultural remote sensing applications ”, Mendeley Data, V1, doi: 10.17632/vz6d7tw87f.1.
`
